newsitem.title: USA: Gabelli funds set year-end distributions.
newsitem.headline: Gabelli funds set year-end distributions.

text.p: Gabelli Asset Fund set a total year-end distribution of $2.77, up from $2.00 previously.
Gabelli Growth Fund set a total year-end distribution of $2.324, down from $3.96 previously.
Gabelli Global Convertible Securities Fund set a total year-end distribution of $1.20 versus $0.393 previously.
Gabelli Global Telecommunications Fund set a total year-end distribution of $0.84 versus $0.182 previously.
Gabelli Global Interactive Couch Potato Fund set a total year end distribution of $1.436, versus $0.363 previously.
All distributions were payable December 31, 1996 to shareholders of record on December 30.
